title: RetroDFM-R: Reasoning-Driven Retrosynthesis Prediction with Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2507.17448v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrosynthetic planning is a cornerstone of organic synthesis and drug discovery. Yet existing AI methods often rely on pattern matching rather than transferable chemical reasoning, limiting both generalizability and interpretability. Here we introduce RetroDFM-R, a reasoning-driven large language model (LLM) for chemical retrosynthesis. Leveraging large-scale reinforcement learning, RetroDFM-R moves beyond black-box prediction by coupling improved accuracy with transparent, step-by-step rationale. On the USPTO-50K benchmark, RetroDFM-R achieves 60.4% accuracy without augmentation and 66.1% with the full inference setup, outperforming previous state-of-the-art baselines. Beyond standard metrics, double-blind expert evaluation further supports the chemical plausibility and practical utility of its proposed pathways. translated_title: RetroDFM-R：通过强化学习与大型语言模型实现推理驱动的逆合成预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.17448v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：逆合成规划是有机合成和药物发现的基石。然而，现有的人工智能方法往往依赖于模式匹配，而非可迁移的化学推理，这限制了其泛化性和可解释性。在此，我们介绍了RetroDFM-R，一种用于化学逆合成的推理驱动型大型语言模型（LLM）。利用大规模强化学习，RetroDFM-R超越了黑箱预测，将改进的准确性与透明、逐步的推理过程相结合。在USPTO-50K基准测试中，RetroDFM-R在无增强条件下达到60.4%的准确率，在完整推理设置下达到66.1%，超越了以往最先进的基线方法。除了标准指标外，双盲专家评估进一步支持了其提出路径的化学合理性和实际实用性。我们还证明了RetroDFM-R能够重建真实世界药物中复杂的多步合成路线。
tldr: 本文提出RetroDFM-R，一种基于强化学习的推理驱动型大型语言模型，通过透明逐步推理实现高准确率的化学逆合成预测，在USPTO-50K基准上达到60.4%至66.1%的准确率，并超越现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RetroDFM-R, a reasoning-driven large language model trained with reinforcement learning that achieves high-accuracy retrosynthesis prediction with transparent step-by-step reasoning, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods on USPTO-50K with 60.4% to 66.1% accuracy.
